text: The China Council for the Promotion of International Trade reported its global trade-friction index at 101 in July 2026, remaining at a high level. The value of trade-restrictive measures fell 18.7% YoY and 2.2% MoM, reflecting a base effect from intensive tariff measures by the
text_zh: 中国国际贸易促进委员会报告称，2026年7月全球贸易摩擦指数为101，持续处于高位。贸易限制措施金额同比下降18.7%，环比下降2.2%，反映出密集关税措施带来的基数效应。
